title.rendered: SportPesa App Download Latest Apk For Android (Official)

content.rendered:
Download latest SportPesa  App for Android latest Apk, which can be installed by Tanzanian and South African users who use SportPesa Official website. SportPesa mobile app runs faster on all Android versions starting from 4.1.

With SportPesa app, placing bet just got easier for you, because you don’t have to visit the official website to search and place bet, all you need to do, is just to add funds from the official website of SportPesa to your account or using other channels that SportPesa provides to fund your account, which you can also see when you install and open the original version of SportPesa App.

SportPesa app runs faster on all version of Android mobile phones without force closing, all recent bugs have been fixed by the developers of the app.

Features Of SportPesa Mobile App

Below are the common features of SportPesa App for Android.

They are:

  • Check highlights.
  • Place live bet.
  • Withdraw funds.
  • View transaction history.
  • View bet history.
  • change country between Kenya and  Tanzania.
  • New JengaBet.
  • Search and bet new games.
  • Register or login to your account within the app.
  • Play Mega Jackpot and jackpot.

Download SportPesa App Apk Official For South Africa And Tanzania

Below are the Sportpesa Official mobile app for Tanzanians and Kenyans:

South Africa

SportPesa Official Android Apk 4.2.0.1 Latest (Za)

Tanzania

SportPesa Official Android Apk 4.2.0.1 Apk (tz)

Tanzania Users: should change to kswahili by clicking More tab, under General, click on change language and select there preferred language.

What’s New

– New interface

– Easy to install, consumes less space on your device.

– New Login and registration interface within the app.
